headline: Harborpath Advisory wants to launch a referral offer quickly: needs written terms and a unique referral link

suggested_routes.label: Deal / partner next step
suggested_routes.rationale: The partner asked to start onboarding and needs written terms, a unique referral link and a contact route to publish an offer.
suggested_routes.output: Partner launch kit, to send (Team member A said "I will send the documents", turn 25): (1) partner memorandum to sign; (2) commission terms in writing: activation USD 260, card bonus tiers and volume bonus, as stated in turn 9; (3) customer pricing in writing (turn 10); (4) a unique referral link plus the tracking sheet (turns 17, 21); (5) referral requirements, including evidence of US operations (turn 13) and the bank-transfer-only receiving limitation (turn 23).
suggested_routes.owner: Team member A (stated, turn 25: "I will send the documents")

suggested_routes.label: Internal / product / vendor note
suggested_routes.rationale: A marketing follow-up was offered: a podcast and a partner-page feature.
suggested_routes.output: Internal note for marketing: the partner proposed a podcast (turn 26); Team member A offered a marketing introduction and a partner-page feature (turn 27). No date or owner on the marketing side is stated.

suggested_routes.label: Sales coaching
suggested_routes.rationale: Good practice: the rep corrected the opening misunderstanding and set compliance expectations before the partner sends referrals.
suggested_routes.output: Reinforce: Team member A corrected the personal-vs-business misunderstanding immediately (turn 2) and volunteered the evidence-of-US-operations requirement (turn 13), so referred businesses are not surprised later.

evidence.quote: My understanding was that you help people open bank accounts remotely.
evidence.supports: The partner arrived with a misunderstanding.

evidence.quote: we work with registered businesses, not individuals opening personal accounts
Usually I receive nothing for the recommendation. If there is a sensible commercial arrangement here, that is interesting to me.
The activation payment is USD 260 when a referred company gets its account approved by our compliance partners.
No, let us get the partner onboarding started.
Another important point is evidence of US operations or intended operations
evidence.supports: A compliance requirement that may block new businesses.

evidence.quote: It cannot depend on me manually writing every email. This needs to scale
evidence.supports: Requirement for a scalable referral mechanism.

evidence.quote: The main thing is to have all of that written down, with the link and contact route.
evidence.supports: What the partner needs to launch.

evidence.quote: I will send the documents and the information discussed here.

concise_output: A partner (Harborpath Advisory) that already recommends account providers wants to publish a SpendNest referral offer quickly. The deal now depends on SpendNest sending written terms, pricing, requirements and a unique referral link.
what_established: The partner asked to start onboarding; terms were stated verbally (USD 260 activation, card spend bonus tiers, volume bonus); the referral link route was agreed; Team member A will send documents.
what_not_established: Signed memorandum, referral volumes, or revenue. The verbal terms are not yet confirmed in writing. Harborpath Advisory is not established to be related to Harborlight Advisory (C01).
next_action: Send the partner launch kit (memorandum, written terms, referral link, requirements) and introduce marketing.
owner: Team member A (speaker label; the organiser-to-speaker mapping is not supplied)
uncertainty: Speaker labels are local to this meeting; who 'Team member A' is in the CRM is not established.
